title: A sprint's goal research story whose questions may add DOC facts has its root's _sources.csv in its touches
goal: new sprint (or planning) gives a goal research story that names a kb root's article the root's _sources.csv in its touches, and the _self rules answer 'may a research item add source rows outside its touches' with a good pack; SP-4o3plg4l's research ST-z7eii5h6 stopped with three DOC facts and their source rows unlanded until the orchestrator widened its touches and resumed it (a second session, about 2.9 USD more)

run: import subprocess,sys;t=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','pack','--root','_self','may a research item add source rows outside its touches'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout;print(t.splitlines()[0] if t else None);sys.exit(0 if t.startswith('coverage: good') else 1)
